plain: Strong encouragement or urging to do something.

webster.text: The act or practice of exhorting; the act of inciting to laudable deeds; incitement to that which is good or commendable.

more.text: The form of words intended to incite and encourage.

example.quote: He concluded with an exhortation, not to suffer the present opportunity of establishing general peace, harmony, happiness and liberty in the U.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, May 29, 1787
